$description: Bounded Systems content tokens — canonical brand copy. The verbal half of the design system: one source of truth for words, the way tokens.json is for visuals. Surfaces (and other repos) may extend this with their own content/strings.json; the content tool merges core + per-repo. Scenarios in content/*.feature assert these are presented consistently.

tagline.$description: Primary tagline — hero / link cards / titles.

description.$value: Capability security for AI agents — authority drawn at the door, not the process or container. Every claim graded against the running code.
description.$description: One-line description — meta description (kept ≤160 chars), intros.

thesis.$value: Draw the boundary at the door — a scope-bounded set of capabilities an agent acts through, not the process, not the container.

keywords.$value: CAPABILITY SECURITY · AGENT INFRASTRUCTURE · AI · DEVELOPER TOOLS
keywords.$description: Short all-caps keyword strip — SVG headers, meta keywords.

approve.$description: Microcopy of the approve page (bdelanghe/chitin crates/chitin-approve): the phone page that approves messages queued to be sent as a person, with a passkey. Placeholders are {name}, filled by the surface; the surface escapes what it fills. Consumers flatten this group to dotted keys (approve.pending.title) and may strip the approve. prefix.

title.$description: apple-mobile-web-app-title meta in every page head: the name under the Home Screen icon on iOS.

name.$description: Web manifest `name`: the installed app's full name.

short_name.$description: Web manifest `short_name`: the label under the installed icon where space is short.

description.$value: Approve messages queued to be sent as you, with a passkey.
description.$description: Web manifest `description`: what the installed app is for, shown by install prompts.

title.$description: Pending page <title> and <h1>. The page script also compares document.title to it to decide whether to reload the list when the app is resumed.

none.$description: Pending page summary paragraph under the heading when no intent waits for the title.

one.$value: One message waits to be sent as {who}. It is sent exactly as shown, once you confirm with your passkey.
one.$description: Pending page summary when exactly one intent waits. {who} is the title messages are sent as (HTML-escaped).

many.$value: {n} messages wait to be sent as {who}. Each is sent exactly as shown, once you confirm it with your passkey.
many.$description: Pending page summary when two or more intents wait. {n} is the count, {who} the title they are sent as (HTML-escaped).

check_again.$description: Pending page link that reloads the list.

add_passkey.$description: Pending page link to the register page.

decline_hint.$value: To decline a message, run {command} at the Mac.
decline_hint.$description: Pending page footnote: declining is not possible from the device, only at the Mac. {command} is pending.decline_command, rendered as code.

decline_command.$description: The command shown verbatim in pending.decline_hint, inside <code>; HTML-escaped at insertion (<id> is a literal placeholder for the reader, not substituted).

heading.$description: Heading of one pending intent; the approve button is described by it. {to} is the recipient (HTML-escaped).

meta.$description: Metadata line under an intent's heading. {age} is a time.* phrase, {by} the unverified queuer, {chars} the length, {hash} the text hash, {id} the intent id.

queued_by_unknown.$description: Stands in for {by} in item.meta when chitin did not say who queued the intent.

approve_button.$description: Button on each pending intent: fetches a challenge and asks for the passkey.

under_a_minute.$description: {age} in item.meta when the intent was queued less than 60 seconds ago.

minutes.$description: {age} in item.meta under an hour: {m} whole minutes.

hours_minutes.$description: {age} in item.meta from an hour on: {h} whole hours and {m} remaining minutes.

intro.$value: Two steps. On this device, create a passkey (Face ID, Touch ID or your password). Then, at the Mac, run one command and confirm it with Touch ID. Until the Mac confirms it, the passkey cannot approve anything as {who}.
intro.$description: Register page intro: the two steps, and that the passkey grants nothing until the Mac endorses it. {who} is the title (HTML-escaped).

step1.$description: Register page heading over the label field and the create button.

label.$description: Register page label of the passkey-name input.

label_placeholder.$description: Placeholder of the passkey-name input: example names.

create_button.$description: Register page button: navigator.credentials.create, then stage the response.

step2.$description: Heading of the section revealed after the passkey is created; focus moves to it.

run_this.$value: Run this in Terminal on the Mac:
run_this.$description: Lead-in to the staged `chitin webauthn register` command shown in Step 2.

touch_id.$value: Touch ID will ask to add a passkey, credential {credential}. Confirm only if that matches. The command works once, within 10 minutes of starting.
touch_id.$description: Step 2 guidance: what the Mac's Touch ID prompt will name and how long the command stays valid. {credential} is the element the script fills with the credential fingerprint.

back.$description: Register page link back to the pending page.

title.$description: Title and heading of the 403 page when a page request fails the gateway's checks; the machine reason from the check follows it.
Title and heading of the error page when the pending list cannot be read from chitin.

no_chitin.$value: the gateway could not run chitin; try again
no_chitin.$description: Reason on the queue error page when chitin could not be run at all.

bad_list.$value: chitin pending exited {status} without a list
bad_list.$description: Reason on the queue error page when chitin ran but printed no list. {status} is the process exit status.

gateway_answered.$description: Page script: the reason used when an API answer is not JSON. {status} is the HTTP status code; it is shown after script.not_sent or script.not_registered.

cancelled.$value: The passkey prompt was cancelled or timed out.
cancelled.$description: Page script: the reason shown when the WebAuthn prompt is dismissed or times out (NotAllowedError).

changed.$value: this message changed since the page loaded. Reload and read it again.
changed.$description: Page script: the reason shown when the challenge's recipient or text differs from what the page shows; nothing is signed.

sent.$description: Page script: live-region and inline result after an approval is accepted. {to} is the recipient, {message} chitin's own message (may be empty).

not_sent.$description: Page script: live-region and inline result when an approval fails. {why} is the reason.

created.$value: Passkey created on this device. It does not count yet: finish at the Mac.
created.$description: Page script: live-region message after the passkey is created and staged, before the Mac endorses it.

not_registered.$description: Page script: live-region message when creating or staging the passkey fails. {why} is the reason.
